faq.question: How quickly can my legal assistant start?
faq.answer: Once we've had our consultation call and confirmed the match, your assistant will be onboarded and working within **72 business hours**. We brief them on your tools, workflow, and firm priorities — you just make the introduction.

faq.question: What tools and systems do they work in?
faq.answer: Your assistant adapts to **whatever your firm already uses** — Clio, MyCase, Filevine, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and more. No new tools, no disruption to how your team works.

faq.question: How bilingual are they?
faq.answer: All YVA professionals are **fully fluent in English and Spanish** — not conversational, fluent. They write client-facing correspondence and handle sensitive conversations in both languages at a professional level.

faq.question: Is there a long-term contract?
faq.answer: We have a service agreement but **no long-term lock-in**. You can exit at any time with no penalties. Our results are what keeps clients with us — not the fine print.

faq.question: What if they're not a good fit for my firm?
faq.answer: Tell us and we'll **rematch you at no extra cost**. We take fit seriously — finding the right person for your team's dynamic and workflow is part of what we do.
